⚔️ Combat
Aimlock: Locks the camera onto enemy heads with configurable prediction, smoothness, and FOV settings.

Melee Spam: Spam attack players within Melee weapon range using your equipped Melee weapon, targeting the head.

👁️ Visuals (ESP)
Player ESP: Draws boxes around players with Name, Distance, and Health-based color indicators.

Item ESP: Highlights important items in the world.

Full Bright: Removes shadows and sets game time to noon for maximum visibility (Keybind: F3).

No Fog: Removes render fog to see clearly across the map.

🏃 Movement
Fly: Allows flight with customizable speed.

Noclip: Allows walking through walls and obstacles.

Infinite Jump: Lets you jump continuously in mid-air.

❤️ Survival & Misc
Auto-Sustain: Automatically fires events to replenish Hunger and Thirst.

Auto-Heal: Automatically triggers Campfire healing and uses Medkits ("God Medkit") from your inventory when health is low.
